title: Follow the Defense
setup: Your rook faces the bishop on d4, which stays where it is only because the knight on f5 covers it.
hint: Do not take the bishop yet. Ask what defends it, and whether you can trade that piece off first.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxf5}} removes the knight that guards d4. {{gxf5}} restores the material but not the defense, and {{Rxd4}} wins a piece. Attack the defender, not the defended. A pawn recapture repairs the material, never the defense.
